title: add-sparse-oci-lockfile-and-unprivileged-runtime-bootstrap
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Reduce airgap bundle size and speed up node bootstrap on minimal distros by generating a sparse OCI lockfile and supporting unprivileged runtime bootstrapping. This PR implements a compact OCI index generator that computes a delta-aware manifest (sparse lockfile) so on-prem registries only need to store referenced layer blobs, and adds an opt-in unprivileged runtime bootstrapping path for systems without systemd or where installers run as a non-root operator. The change touches three areas: (1) mirroring pipeline: new mirroring script and Terraform module extensions to publish sparse lockfiles and sign them; (2) bootstrap runtime: a new runit/runc shim and containerd prefetch hook that runs under a control-plane service account to pull minimal images during node init; (3) upgrade and rollback hooks: an atomic apply flow that uses filesystem snapshots (zfs/btrfs fallback) to enable fast rollback when partial image syncs occur. Backwards compatibility: mirror registry still supports full bundles, nodes that don't opt into the sparse flow continue to use existing OCI manifests. Security: lockfiles are signed with GPG/KMS and verified by the bootstrapper; unprivileged pull uses a gated helper that only has pull scope. Includes docs and e2e tests. Testing: local mirror e2e with k3s and microk8s, upgrade/rollback smoke tests on a 3-node airgapped cluster. See linked Linear for rollout plan.
